log.msg: screenshots: 4 surfaces (Refine demo, Dictate page, drawer AI tab, ai2 card) x 4 widths x before/after, headless against a private PORT=58412 server; saved under one-input/proof/ (not shots/ — that pattern is gitignored, 'never committed'); console clean except pre-existing by-design 404s (page.jsonl/weight.jsonl/settings.jsonl probes, directory.json frozen, ai2's usage.json) verified identical before and after

Dictate page and the drawer AI tab were already on composer() via ux/Dictate/Widget.js — only RefineDemo needed moving; confirmed with screenshots, no code change needed there beyond the shared Composer.js/Mic.js shape+wiring change

decision.what: dropped VoiceStrip from RefineDemo entirely rather than keeping it as a status line
decision.why: it runs its own separate Dictate instance; ComposerMic's one-mic-at-a-time guard only covers composer mics, so running both risked two live mics at once. The composer's own .chatbox-compose-diag line already says the same mic/whisper health.

decision.what: gated the live-refine POST (refine_tick/refine_final) on this.revise, the same switch clean_active() already reads
decision.why: law 6 says every mic refines live, but posting from every bare mic:true composer (cards with no revise pipeline) would be noise with no payoff; revise is the existing signal for 'this composer runs the dictation pipeline'.

log.msg: stopped the private dev server (PORT=58412) and removed the scratch launcher scripts; port confirmed free
